subject: Apexium Labs: technical handshake + cadence for post-discovery deep-dive
messages:
From: James Lowe <james@apexium.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 05 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Post-discovery: scheduling an infra + SLA deep-dive

Hi Hannah / Ben,

Thanks again for the discovery session yesterday — that was helpful. Apexium would like to move to a technical deep-dive to validate fit and get an implementation cadence nailed down. We're targeting a 75- to 90-minute session to cover: architecture alignment (model serving topology), latency/SLO expectations, data privacy constraints, and an initial rollout plan (canary/rollback).

Attendees from our side: Amira Singh (CTO), Raj Patel (infra lead), and me (sales). We prefer the week of Nov 9th in the mornings Pacific. Can you propose two slots and a short agenda? Also let us know if you need any artifacts ahead of time (network diagrams, expected QPS, token budgets).

Thanks,
James
James Lowe
VP Partnerships, Apexium Labs
james@apexium.ai

--
Attachment: discovery-notes-APX.pdf (summary of discovery session)
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: James Lowe <james@apexium.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 06 Nov 2026 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: scheduling an infra + SLA deep-dive

Hi James — great to hear. Happy to run the deep-dive and surface a practical rollout cadence. Proposed slots (all PT):

- Tue Nov 10, 9:00–10:30 AM PT
- Wed Nov 11, 10:30–12:00 PM PT

Proposed 75-minute agenda (we'll keep an extra 15 for buffer / live Q&A):
1) 10 min — goals & success criteria (your side)
2) 25 min — serving topology recommendations (hosted vs dedicated vs private)
3) 20 min — latency/SLO and cost tradeoffs (batching, quantization, routing policies)
4) 15 min — security/compliance checklist and required artifacts
5) 5–15 min — next steps / rollouts / open action items

Please confirm which slot works and whether you'd like us to include a short primer on our runtime internals for your infra lead. I'm attaching a pre-demo checklist we use to speed the session prep.

Hannah Schmitt
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com

--
Attachments: pre-demo-checklist.pdf, rdw-apexium-demo-agenda.docx
From: Amira Singh <amira.singh@apexium.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: James Lowe <james@apexium.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 07 Nov 2026 08:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: scheduling an infra + SLA deep-dive

Thanks Hannah — appreciate the clear agenda. Quick note: our CTO (me) has a board prep conflict on Nov 10th morning and Raj is out all day Nov 11th. Could we move to Tue Nov 16th 8:30–10:00 AM PT or Wed Nov 17th 9:00–10:30 AM PT?

Two asks before the session that will make the time most effective:
- Can you include a short section (10–15 min) covering how Redwood handles data residency and audit logs in private deployments? We need to validate KMS/HSM integrations and retention windows.
- If you can share a brief template of the rollout cadence (canary size, fallback policy, metrics to watch) that'd be helpful; Raj will add our QPS/CPU expectations to it prior to the call.

I can loop in our security owner if needed but would prefer to keep this session focused on infra + rollout first.

Best,
Amira
CTO, Apexium Labs
amira.singh@apexium.ai
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Amira Singh <amira.singh@apexium.ai>, James Lowe <james@apexium.ai>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 15:41:00 -0800
Subject: Confirmed: Apexium technical deep-dive (Tue Nov 16, 8:30–10:00 AM PT)

Hi Amira / James — confirmed. I've scheduled Tue Nov 16, 8:30–10:00 AM PT and shared a calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=apexium-deepdive-20261109

Attendees from Redwood: Ben Carter (SE lead), Hannah Schmitt (solutions engineer), Karthik Iyer (security/compliance SME, will cover KMS/HSM & audit logging).
From Apexium: Amira Singh (CTO), Raj Patel (infra lead), James Lowe (sales).

We will open with a 10-minute alignment on goals, then walk through the serving topology (hosted/dedicated/private tradeoffs) and a concrete rollout cadence that includes canary parameters, fallback policy, and the three metrics we'll instrument for regressions. I'll bring a short example of our canary runbook during the call.

Pre-reads attached: rdw-apexium-demo-agenda.docx, pre-demo-checklist.pdf

If you want us to loop in your security owner for the final 15 minutes, reply-all and we'll extend the calendar by 15 minutes.

Thanks — looking forward.
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
